# ga-engine

> A modular, dependency-light (NumPy only) genetic algorithm library for Python. It optimises real, integer, binary and permutation problems, supports constraints, multi-objective optimisation (NSGA-II), parallel evaluation, an island model, and exactly-resumable checkpoints. All objectives are minimised.

Start with the LLM guide: it is self-contained and lists every parameter, template and common mistake.

## Primary

- [LLM guide](LLM_GUIDE.md): complete contract for writing correct code with this library, with runnable templates.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): overview, installation, quick start, examples.
- [User guide](docs/user-guide.md): tutorial for every capability.
- [Configuration reference](docs/configuration.md): every option with defaults and validation rules.
- [Operators](docs/operators.md): which operators exist for which genome, with parameters.
- [Checkpoints](docs/checkpoints.md): guarantees and file format.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): modules, layers and data flow.
- [API reference](docs/api.md): generated from the source.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): error messages and fixes.
